name: Prabowo Subianto
quote: Let us also pray for our brothers and sisters affected by the disaster in East Nusa Tenggara and other regions of the homeland.

name: Berton Suar Pelita Panjaitan
quote: The death toll continues to rise as our teams reach areas that were previously cut off by landslides — we are updating figures daily as verification continues.

name: Pratikno
role: Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture
quote: We are here to ensure the central government's response reaches every affected regency, not just the accessible ones.

name: Dody Hanggodo
quote: Clearing the Trans-Flores highway is our top infrastructure priority — every day it stays blocked delays aid to the interior.

name: Emanuel Melkiades Laka Lena
quote: We are declaring a 14-day state of emergency to unlock every resource the provincial government has to reach our people.

name: TNI Field Command (East Nusa Tenggara Deployment)
role: Indonesian National Armed Forces — Emergency Response Task Force
quote: We have grown our footprint from roughly 1,200 to more than 3,500 personnel in two days — our focus now is reaching Manggarai and Maumere's most isolated hamlets.

name: Basarnas Leadership
role: Head, National Search and Rescue Agency (Basarnas)
quote: Our capacity needs to grow to match the scale of disasters we face, not shrink — that has been our warning for this budget cycle.

name: BMKG Seismology Spokesperson
quote: This is thrust-fault movement on the Flores Back-Arc Thrust — the same structure behind the 1992 tsunami — and we expect continued aftershock activity for another three to four weeks.

name: World Bank Indonesia Country Office
quote: We are prepared to commit $50 million in emergency recovery funding once the full damage assessment is complete.

name: IFRC / Indonesian Red Cross (PMI) Field Coordinator
role: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies
quote: We are preparing shelter, water and hygiene support for roughly 2,000 people in temporary sites while the broader needs assessment continues.

name: Lawrence Wong
quote: I have written to President Prabowo to extend Singapore's condolences to all those affected by this tragedy on Flores.

name: Unnamed Village Resident, Manggarai Regency
quote: As for help from the government, there hasn't been any — no tents, no medicine, no food, no drinking water, nothing.
